# Digital Magician
> Digital Magician is a results-driven digital marketing institute in Sonipat, Haryana (serving Haryana & Delhi NCR, plus a live online batch across India). It trains students on real client campaigns — Google Ads, Meta Ads, SEO, and AI tools — and backs every course with a written 100% placement guarantee (placed in 30 days or full refund). 500+ students trained.

## About
- [About Digital Magician](https://digitalmagician.in/about): The institute, its practitioner-led approach, and founder story.
- [Placement Guarantee](https://digitalmagician.in/placement): How the 100% placement guarantee works — placed in 30 days or a full refund. 80% placed within 30 days, 10+ hiring partners.
- [Digital Marketing Salary Guide (Haryana & Delhi NCR)](https://digitalmagician.in/salary-guide): Real salary data by role, experience, and city.
- [Contact](https://digitalmagician.in/contact): Phone +91-79882-27240, campus in Model Town, Sonipat, Haryana.

## Programs (full courses)
- [Full Stack Digital Marketing Course](https://digitalmagician.in/programs/full-stack-digital-marketing): 4 months training + 2 months internship. AI + Google Ads + Meta Ads + SEO + content. Dual certification. Fee ₹45,000 (from ₹60,000), EMI available.
- [Performance Marketing Course](https://digitalmagician.in/programs/performance-marketing): 2 months. Full-funnel paid acquisition across Google & Meta. Fee ₹25,000.
- [Google Ads Mastery Course](https://digitalmagician.in/programs/google-ads-mastery): 2 months. Search, Display, YouTube, Performance Max. Fee ₹25,000.
- [Meta Ads Mastery Course](https://digitalmagician.in/programs/meta-ads-mastery): 2 months. Facebook & Instagram ads, Pixel, creative. Fee ₹25,000.
- [SEO Mastery Course](https://digitalmagician.in/programs/seo-mastery): 2 months. Technical, on-page, off-page, AI SEO. Fee ₹25,000.
- [Website Development Course](https://digitalmagician.in/programs/website-development): 2 months. WordPress, page builders, AI tools, no-code. Fee ₹20,000.
